efv-8-mars.name: Efv-8 Mars
efv-8-mars.description: The standard issue personal Efervon projector, as sported by all ranks of Scaldra.

embolist.name: Embolist
embolist.description: A living weapon, the infested Embolist pistol kills its victims with an acidic venomous gas.

epitaph.name: Epitaph
epitaph.description: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.

epitaph-prime.name: Epitaph Prime
epitaph-prime.description: Send shivers down your enemies' spines with this wrist-mounted sidearm. As the signature weapon of Sevagoth Prime, it deals additional headshot damage when wielded by him.

euphona-prime.name: Euphona Prime
euphona-prime.description: Banshee Prime's signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.
